propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 both declare a 1,000,000 token window, making escalation from sonnet to opus buy zero additional context capacity.

A context-limit retry on opus fails at the same limit as sonnet, wasting opus pricing and second round-trip, while the failure silently appears to mean opus itself is insufficient rather than revealing no real escalation occurred.
Both declared window figures are verified correct against the provider's live Models API max_input_tokens; the defect is in ladder consumption, not in the table itself.
New function escalation_rungs() must filter models_at_or_above() to exclude rungs whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung, applied to both context-limit retry loops.
Structural guards require MODEL_LADDER windows to be non-decreasing and escalation_rungs() windows to be strictly increasing from every start rung.
